neighbours.label: ' that' right after an abstract noun: 'The claim that', 'the notion that', 'the theory that'
fire: The claim that the earth is flat is false.
The silly idea that cats hate water spread.
The belief that prices always rise is old.
He rejected the notion that art is useless.
The rumor that she quit is untrue.
The theory that birds evolved from dinosaurs is old.
Note the concept that is used here.
They doubted the report that he had died.
quiet: He said that the earth is flat.
The silly man said cats hate water.
We know that prices always rise.
He rejected the plan and left.
She quit and it is true.
I think that birds evolved from dinosaurs.
Note the page that you used.
They said that he had died.

notes: The card flags the pole as broad and corpus max is 1.12. 'Note the page that you used' is a relative clause, so it tests the abstract-noun part directly.
